text:
release-bot: preflight check FAILED for release v2026.03.21-rc2 — env-parity mismatch between staging and prod. Blocking promotion.
release-bot: Missing secret key in prod: `keystore/model_variant_pin` (present in staging). Feature flag mismatch: `enable_quant_fallback`=true in staging vs false in prod.
sara: ugh, saw this when I tried promoting. the model pin change landed in staging yesterday.
mike: we didn't plan a keystore write to prod during this window. where did the `MODEL_VARIANT_PIN` env come from?
olivia: looks like the helm values for the inference svc added `modelVariantPin: ${PIN}` in the last commit (git sha a1b2c3).
sara: snippet from deploy manifest:```yaml
env:
  - name: MODEL_VARIANT_PIN
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: model-keystore
        key: model_variant_pin
```
jordan: so staging has the secret and manifest wired, prod doesn't — promoting will change runtime model behavior. that's risky for canary.
mike: options: 1) backfill prod keystore with the key (fast but needs creds & audit), 2) remove the pin from manifest and promote (safer for parity), 3) revert the commit and rerun after change window.
sara: my preference is to HOLD the promotion. we should avoid changing model selection logic mid-window.
olivia: agree. we also need release notes + a rollback playbook in case someone force-promotes.
mike: I can script a keystore put and smoke test, but I need 3-4h for approvals and verification.
jordan: given the time, holding until the next change window is reasonable. what's our next window?
release-bot: next approved change window: 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Release status set to BLOCKED.
sara: plan: 1) mike will prepare backfill script + test in staging namespace 2) olivia will update release notes and add rollback commands 3) jordan will add an alert for model-variant drift post-deploy 4) if not done before window, we will remove the model-pin from values and promote without the change.
mike: assigned. I'll post the script and verification steps here when ready.
olivia: adding release note entry: "DEFERRED: model-variant pin change — backfill scheduled. Promotion blocked until keystore parity confirmed."
sara: also add an integration test that asserts `enable_quant_fallback` parity across envs.
jordan: +1 on automated parity check. would have caught this earlier.
release-bot: reminder: release ticket #INF-1243 updated to BLOCKED state and annotated with parity failure.
mike: ETA ~3.5h for backfill + smoke. will request emergency approvals if needed.
sara: if approvals drag, fallback = strip `MODEL_VARIANT_PIN` from the chart and promote. we'll include a post-deploy quality check (sampling and metric diff).
jordan: I'll create an alert: if model selection distribution changes >5% in 10m, slack @eng-sre.
olivia: all set on notes. will also add a short blurb for customers in release notes about deferring model pin.
sara: thanks team. keep this thread updated. :eyes:
release-bot: thread closed for now — release remains BLOCKED until parity is confirmed or chart reverted.
